page_air_bridges.hero_desc: Intelligent autonomous logistics network. We create transport corridors where roads end. A revolution in critical cargo delivery.
page_air_bridges.commercial_desc: The Air Bridges project aims to radically reduce the cost and time of cargo delivery to geographically challenging regions. The use of autonomous heavy-duty UAVs allows for abandoning expensive ground infrastructure and waiting for weather windows for traditional aviation.
page_air_bridges.intel_desc: The drone's sensor system analyzes terrain and biometric data in real-time. Status: Data collection complete.
page_air_bridges.vr_desc: The remote piloting system allows the operator to be in the drone's cockpit while thousands of kilometers away. Full immersion and neural feedback.

page_arachnid.goal_text: Autonomous robotic system for cleaning the hulls of large-tonnage ships right on the go.
page_arachnid.hero_desc: Small robot with advanced magnetic suction technology. Working with a central streamlined hub, Sprut robots move along the ship's perimeter and clean shells and marine growth using ultra-high pressure water jets.
page_arachnid.tech_1_desc: The smart streamlined hub attaches to the ship's bow, reducing water resistance. Moving towards the stern, it serves as a single pressurized water supply point for a group of robots.
page_arachnid.tech_2_desc: Sprut's advanced electromagnetic manipulators securely hold the robot to the hull even in strong currents while the ship is moving at cruising speed.
page_arachnid.tech_3_desc: Basic models have remote camera control. In the premium line, artificial intelligence automatically assesses work quality and calculates the frequency of necessary cleanings.
page_arachnid.funding_desc: Your contribution will accelerate the creation of the Sprut system. All donations are distributed through the A-LAB DAO smart contract.

page_vtemnote.title: VTEMNOTE — Sensory Evolution | A-LAB.TECH
page_vtemnote.hero_sub: The Vtemnote project is an innovative platform for rebooting reality and adapting to uncertainty. We offer an experience that frees you from visual noise, restores trust in yourself and others, and reveals true potential through immersion in total darkness.
page_vtemnote.section_1_p1: In a world full of variables, we have forgotten how to trust intuition. The habit of relying only on sight forms an illusion of control: "if I see it, it must be true." The Vtemnote project breaks this myth by immersing you in total darkness, where sight ceases to be a point of support.
page_vtemnote.feat_1_desc: Training survival skills in uncomfortable situations. Face to face with the unknown, you learn to find support within yourself when external landmarks disappear.
page_vtemnote.feat_2_desc: Therapy for an overloaded nervous system and eyes. Relieving stress from screens by rebooting other senses and natural intuition.
page_vtemnote.feat_3_desc: In the dark, there are no badges, titles, or assessment by appearance. An ideal environment for introverts and a powerful trainer for sincere, non-judgmental communication and team trust.

page_legal.title: Legal Information
page_legal.privacy_s1_text: A-LAB.TECH collects data necessary for the functioning of the platform and resident interaction, including: personal data, professional portfolio, Astra token transaction data, and digital footprints of interface interaction.
page_legal.privacy_s2_l1: Ensuring the security of resident accounts.
page_legal.privacy_s2_l2: Analyzing the effectiveness of R&D projects.
page_legal.privacy_s3_text: A-LAB does not store user private keys. The resident bears sole responsibility for the security of their wallet (MetaMask, etc.) and the safety of Astra tokens in On-chain. Loss of access to the wallet means irrevocable loss of assets.
page_legal.charter_s1_text: An A-LAB resident is an authorized DAO member who has passed verification. Status grants access to resources, R&D projects, and the Astra financial ecosystem.
page_legal.charter_s2_l1: 2.1 Welcome Bonus: Each new resident receives a starter pack of 150 ASTRA (equivalent to ~$225) upon registration. This is a share in the overall success of the Laboratory.
page_legal.charter_s2_l2: 2.2 Vesting Period: The ability to claim ASTRA tokens in On-chain opens after 6 months of activity. Exchange for fiat or listing — after 1 year.
page_legal.charter_s2_l3: 2.3 Growth Strategy: Community value is determined by aggregate intellectual capital. Any actions aimed at devaluation or artificial manipulation of the Astra exchange rate lead to an immediate ban.
page_legal.charter_s3_text: Votes in the DAO are distributed proportionally to the number of Astra tokens in the resident's wallet. The minimum threshold for creating a proposal is 1000 Astra.
page_legal.charter_s4_text: The platform undertakes to ensure transparency of token accrual and growth of their value through real industrial contracts. The resident undertakes to make an intellectual contribution to the development of the ecosystem.
page_legal.nda_p1: Working in A-LAB implies access to confidential developments in the spheres of Automotive, Aerospace and Robotics.
page_legal.nda_l1: Publishing materials of projects in "TOP SECRET" status without written permission is prohibited.
page_legal.nda_l2: All developments (code, drawings, prompts) created within paid contracts are the property of the Laboratory.
page_legal.nda_l3: Disclosure of technical details to third parties entails legal liability and exclusion from the DAO.
page_legal.dao_s1_text: Any attempts to conduct Sybil attacks (multiple accounts to capture voting power) or exploit smart contract vulnerabilities for unauthorized receipt of Astra tokens are punished by lifelong exclusion from the DAO with cancellation of all assets.
page_legal.dao_s2_text: Residents are obliged to respect each other's intellectual contribution. Plagiarism of code or concepts within the Laboratory is grounds for DAO arbitration.
page_legal.dao_s3_text: All disputes arising within joint projects are resolved through the DAO Arbitration Committee. The committee's decision is final and is recorded in the resident's reputation history.
page_legal.ip_s1_text: A-LAB recognizes the contribution of each resident. Intellectual Property (IP) rights can be partially tokenized and expressed in Astra tokens.
page_legal.ip_s2_text: Upon commercial realization of a product, residents whose ideas were used have the right to receive royalties (in fiat or tokens), according to the project's smart contract.
page_legal.ip_s3_text: Issued NFT badges are an indivisible confirmation of the resident's qualification and contribution. Buying and selling badges is prohibited by ecosystem rules unless otherwise provided by the rules of a specific badge.
page_legal.footer: © 2026 A-LAB.TECH LEGAL DEPARTMENT. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

page_whitepaper.title:
ASTRA
TOKENOMICS
page_whitepaper.abstract: Official technical document (Whitepaper) of the A-LAB decentralized economic system. Tokenization of intellectual potential and R&D assets.
page_whitepaper.s1_p1: The A-LAB economy is fundamentally different from speculative crypto models. The value of the ASTRA token is directly tied to the volume of real contracts in the industrial sector (Automotive, Aerospace, Industrial Robotics).
page_whitepaper.s1_p2: Each concluded contract generates profit, which is distributed into the token collateral pool. The more complex the project and the more residents (engineers, designers, AI architects) involved in its implementation, the higher the Value Multiplier applied to the token.
page_whitepaper.s1_p3: When A-LAB projects enter the global market (Global Launch), a "quantum leap" in value occurs, as the internal value is confirmed by external market demand for the developed products.
page_whitepaper.s1_formula_note: * Value grows proportionally to the sum of closed contracts and the number of engaged minds.
page_whitepaper.s2_p1: The ASTRA token is not a speculative tool. It is the "fuel" for the ecosystem.
page_whitepaper.s2_l1_text: A flexible contracting system allows for paying a resident's work partially in fiat (to a bank account) and partially in ASTRA tokens as a bonus or investment share.
page_whitepaper.s2_l2_text: Payment for micro-services between residents (design, code, consulting) within the A-LAB circuit.
page_whitepaper.s2_l3_text: Purchase of computing power for rendering or access to private AI models.
page_whitepaper.s2_l4_text: Token holders determine which project the lab will develop next.
page_whitepaper.s3_p1: Emission is strictly limited to create a deflationary model.
page_whitepaper.s4_p1_desc: Launch of the internal transaction database. Testing of the token accrual mechanics for collaborations. Manual rate regulation by the administrator.
page_whitepaper.s4_p2_desc: Token release on Ethereum/TON network. Airdrop of real tokens to residents according to their internal balances. Integration with Web3 wallets.
page_whitepaper.s4_p3_desc: Listing on DEX (Uniswap). Creation of liquidity pools. Ability for external investors to exchange ASTRA for fiat money.
page_whitepaper.footer_line2: NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE. FOR INTERNAL USE ONLY.
